lines.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu wǒ yào qù túshūguǎn huán shū, nǐ yào yìqǐ qù ma?
lines.english: After class I'm going to the library to return some books. Do you want to come?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊，我也有兩本書要還。回來的時候，我們順便去超商吧，我想買明天早上吃的麵包。
lines.simplified: 好啊，我也有两本书要还。回来的时候，我们顺便去超商吧，我想买明天早上吃的面包。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒ yě yǒu liǎng běn shū yào huán. Huílái de shíhòu, wǒmen shùnbiàn qù chāoshāng ba, wǒ xiǎng mǎi míngtiān zǎoshàng chī de miànbāo.
lines.english: Sure, I have two books to return too. On the way back, let's stop at the convenience store. I want to buy bread for tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可以，可是我五點以前得回宿舍，室友要跟我討論報告。
lines.simplified: 可以，可是我五点以前得回宿舍，室友要跟我讨论报告。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, kěshì wǒ wǔ diǎn yǐqián děi huí sùshè, shìyǒu yào gēn wǒ tǎolùn bàogào.
lines.english: OK, but I have to be back at the dorm before five. My roommate wants to discuss our report with me.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的想順便做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的想顺便做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiǎng shùnbiàn zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man want to do on the way?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù túshūguǎn jiè shū.
choices.english: Borrow books from the library.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huí sùshè tǎolùn bàogào.
choices.english: Go back to the dorm to discuss a report.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn shìyǒu yìqǐ chīfàn.
choices.english: Eat with his roommate.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù mǎi míngtiān de zǎofàn.
choices.english: Buy tomorrow's breakfast.

questions.why: 回來的時候，我們順便去超商吧，我想買明天早上吃的麵包: on the way back he wants to stop for tomorrow's breakfast. They go to the library only to return books, and the report is the woman's plan.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你要去一家做電腦遊戲的公司上班？可是那裡給的錢比你現在的公司少很多啊。
lines.simplified: 听说你要去一家做电脑游戏的公司上班？可是那里给的钱比你现在的公司少很多啊。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ yào qù yì jiā zuò diànnǎo yóuxì de gōngsī shàngbān? Kěshì nàlǐ gěi de qián bǐ nǐ xiànzài de gōngsī shǎo hěn duō a.
lines.english: I hear you're going to work for a company that makes computer games? But they pay a lot less than your company now.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對，一個月少一萬塊。我原來打算明年再換，可是設計遊戲是我從小的夢想，就算錢少一點，我也要去。下個月就開始上班了。
lines.simplified: 对，一个月少一万块。我原来打算明年再换，可是设计游戏是我从小的梦想，就算钱少一点，我也要去。下个月就开始上班了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, yí ge yuè shǎo yí wàn kuài. Wǒ yuánlái dǎsuàn míngnián zài huàn, kěshì shèjì yóuxì shì wǒ cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng, jiùsuàn qián shǎo yìdiǎn, wǒ yě yào qù. Xià ge yuè jiù kāishǐ shàngbān le.
lines.english: Yes, ten thousand less a month. At first I planned to change next year, but designing games has been my dream since I was little. Even if the pay is lower, I'm going. I start next month.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 原來是這樣，那你要加油啊！
lines.simplified: 原来是这样，那你要加油啊！
lines.pinyin: Yuánlái shì zhèyàng, nà nǐ yào jiāyóu a!
lines.english: I see. Well, go for it!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What is the man going to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liú zài xiànzài de gōngsī.
choices.english: Stay at the company he is at now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngnián zài qù xīn gōngsī.
choices.english: Go to the new company next year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn kuài jiù yào qù xīn gōngsī.
choices.english: Go to the new company soon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng xīn gōngsī duō gěi diǎn qián.
choices.english: Ask the new company for more money.

questions.why: 就算錢少一點，我也要去。下個月就開始上班了: even with lower pay he is going, and he starts next month. Changing next year was only his first plan (原來打算), and he never talks of staying or of asking for more money.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 學校旁邊那家小咖啡店，最近每天都有很多人排隊。
lines.simplified: 学校旁边那家小咖啡店，最近每天都有很多人排队。
lines.pinyin: Xuéxiào pángbiān nà jiā xiǎo kāfēi diàn, zuìjìn měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō rén páiduì.
lines.english: That little café next to school has had long queues every day lately.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個月有一位明星在那裡拍廣告，那家店就因為這個廣告而變得很有名了。
lines.simplified: 上个月有一位明星在那里拍广告，那家店就因为这个广告而变得很有名了。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè yǒu yí wèi míngxīng zài nàlǐ pāi guǎnggào, nà jiā diàn jiù yīnwèi zhège guǎnggào ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng le.
lines.english: Last month a star shot an ad there, and the café became famous because of that ad.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 難怪！我還以為是那裡的咖啡特別好喝呢。
lines.simplified: 难怪！我还以为是那里的咖啡特别好喝呢。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài! Wǒ hái yǐwéi shì nàlǐ de kāfēi tèbié hǎohē ne.
lines.english: No wonder! I thought it was because their coffee was especially good.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那家咖啡店為什麼變得有名？
prompt.simplified: 那家咖啡店为什么变得有名？
prompt.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēi diàn wèishénme biàn de yǒumíng?
prompt.english: Why did the café become famous?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店出現在明星的廣告裡
choices.simplified: 店出现在明星的广告里
choices.pinyin: Diàn chūxiàn zài míngxīng de guǎnggào lǐ.
choices.english: It appeared in a star's ad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ de kāfēi tèbié hǎohē.
choices.english: Its coffee is especially good.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chángcháng yǒu míngxīng lái hē kāfēi.
choices.english: Stars often come for coffee.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn yǐqián shì yí wèi míngxīng.
choices.english: The owner used to be a star.

questions.why: 那家店就因為這個廣告而變得很有名了: a star shot an ad there, and that ad made the café famous. The good coffee is only what the woman thought (我還以為), and nobody says stars come often or that the owner was a star.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你看過這部電影了嗎？聽說導演花了五年才拍完。
lines.simplified: 你看过这部电影了吗？听说导演花了五年才拍完。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn guo zhè bù diànyǐng le ma? Tīngshuō dǎoyǎn huā le wǔ nián cái pāi wán.
lines.english: Have you seen this film? I hear the director took five years to finish shooting it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 看過了。演員演得好，故事也很讓人感動，可以說是我今年看過最好的電影。不過有一點長，看了快三個小時。
lines.simplified: 看过了。演员演得好，故事也很让人感动，可以说是我今年看过最好的电影。不过有一点长，看了快三个小时。
lines.pinyin: Kàn guo le. Yǎnyuán yǎn de hǎo, gùshì yě hěn ràng rén gǎndòng, kěyǐ shuō shì wǒ jīnnián kàn guo zuì hǎo de diànyǐng. Búguò yǒu yìdiǎn cháng, kàn le kuài sān ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: I have. The acting is good and the story is very moving. You could say it's the best film I've seen this year. It's a bit long, though: almost three hours.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我這個週末也要去看。
lines.simplified: 那我这个周末也要去看。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ zhège zhōumò yě yào qù kàn.
lines.english: Then I'll go and see it this weekend too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這部電影怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这部电影怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè bù diànyǐng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of this film?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tài cháng le, bú tài hǎokàn.
choices.english: It is too long and not very good.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 今年沒看過比這部好的
choices.simplified: 今年没看过比这部好的
choices.pinyin: Jīnnián méi kàn guo bǐ zhè bù hǎo de.
choices.english: He hasn't seen a better film this year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gùshì méi shénme tèbié de.
choices.english: The story is nothing special.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shì tā qùnián kàn guo zuì hǎo de.
choices.english: It is the best film he saw last year.

questions.why: 可以說是我今年看過最好的電影: no film he has seen this year is better. He says 今年, not 去年; the film is 有一點長 but not bad; and he finds the story 很讓人感動.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天去爬山的東西都準備好了嗎？
lines.simplified: 明天去爬山的东西都准备好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān qù pá shān de dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
lines.english: Have you got everything ready for tomorrow's hike?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 差不多了。不過聽說山上的天氣一會兒出太陽，一會兒下雨，晚上還很冷。
lines.simplified: 差不多了。不过听说山上的天气一会儿出太阳，一会儿下雨，晚上还很冷。
lines.pinyin: Chàbùduō le. Búguò tīngshuō shānshàng de tiānqì yìhuǐr chū tàiyáng, yìhuǐr xiàyǔ, wǎnshàng hái hěn lěng.
lines.english: Almost. But I hear the weather on the mountain is sunny one moment and rainy the next, and it gets cold at night.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳得帶一件厚外套，還有手套。妳有手套嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你得带一件厚外套，还有手套。你有手套吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ děi dài yí jiàn hòu wàitào, hái yǒu shǒutào. Nǐ yǒu shǒutào ma?
lines.english: Then you need a thick jacket, and gloves too. Do you have gloves?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒有，我等一下去樓下的超商買一雙。對了，我們明天幾點在哪裡見面？
lines.simplified: 没有，我等一下去楼下的超商买一双。对了，我们明天几点在哪里见面？
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ děng yíxià qù lóuxià de chāoshāng mǎi yì shuāng. Duìle, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn zài nǎlǐ jiànmiàn?
lines.english: No, I'll buy a pair at the store downstairs in a bit. By the way, what time and where are we meeting tomorrow?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 早上六點半在捷運站門口，別遲到喔，車子七點就開了，八點就到山下了。
lines.simplified: 早上六点半在捷运站门口，别迟到喔，车子七点就开了，八点就到山下了。
lines.pinyin: Zǎoshàng liù diǎn bàn zài jiéyùn zhàn ménkǒu, bié chídào o, chēzi qī diǎn jiù kāi le, bā diǎn jiù dào shānxià le.
lines.english: Six-thirty in the morning at the MRT station entrance. Don't be late: the bus leaves at seven, and we'll be at the foot of the mountain by eight.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 山上的天氣怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 山上的天气怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Shānshàng de tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is the weather like on the mountain?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn shǎo biàn, wǎnshàng bù lěng.
choices.english: The weather rarely changes, and the nights are not cold.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tiānqì hěn shǎo biàn, wǎnshàng hěn lěng.
choices.english: The weather rarely changes, and the nights are cold.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 天氣變得很快，晚上不冷
choices.simplified: 天气变得很快，晚上不冷
choices.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn de hěn kuài, wǎnshàng bù lěng.
choices.english: The weather changes fast, and the nights are not cold.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 天氣變得很快，晚上很冷
choices.simplified: 天气变得很快，晚上很冷
choices.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn de hěn kuài, wǎnshàng hěn lěng.
choices.english: The weather changes fast, and the nights are cold.

questions.why: 一會兒出太陽，一會兒下雨: sun one moment and rain the next, so the weather changes fast; and 晚上還很冷 says the nights are cold.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們明天幾點見面？
prompt.simplified: 他们明天几点见面？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn jiànmiàn?
prompt.english: What time are they meeting tomorrow?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liù diǎn bàn.
choices.english: Six-thirty.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qī diǎn.
choices.english: Seven o'clock.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qī diǎn bàn.
choices.english: Seven-thirty.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bā diǎn.
choices.english: Eight o'clock.

questions.why: 早上六點半在捷運站門口: they meet at six-thirty. Seven is when the bus leaves, and eight is when they reach the mountain.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們怎麼這麼晚才回來？不是只去樓下超商買個晚飯嗎？
lines.simplified: 你们怎么这么晚才回来？不是只去楼下超商买个晚饭吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zěnme zhème wǎn cái huílái? Bú shì zhǐ qù lóuxià chāoshāng mǎi ge wǎnfàn ma?
lines.english: Why are you back so late? Weren't you just getting dinner at the store downstairs?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 別說了。店裡人不多，可是兒子一會兒要吃熱狗，一會兒又說要吃泡麵，選了半個小時才選好。
lines.simplified: 别说了。店里人不多，可是儿子一会儿要吃热狗，一会儿又说要吃泡面，选了半个小时才选好。
lines.pinyin: Bié shuō le. Diàn lǐ rén bù duō, kěshì érzi yìhuǐr yào chī règǒu, yìhuǐr yòu shuō yào chī pàomiàn, xuǎn le bàn ge xiǎoshí cái xuǎn hǎo.
lines.english: Don't ask. The store wasn't busy, but our son wanted a hot dog one moment and instant noodles the next. It took him half an hour to choose.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那他要喝什麼？你不會又讓他買汽水了吧？那個喝多了對身體不好。
lines.simplified: 那他要喝什么？你不会又让他买汽水了吧？那个喝多了对身体不好。
lines.pinyin: Nà tā yào hē shénme? Nǐ bú huì yòu ràng tā mǎi qìshuǐ le ba? Nàge hē duō le duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
lines.english: And what did he want to drink? You didn't let him buy soda again, did you? Drinking too much of that is bad for you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他本來要買，我跟他說喝牛奶或是豆漿才長得高，可是他都不肯喝，最後自己去拿了一瓶果汁。
lines.simplified: 他本来要买，我跟他说喝牛奶或是豆浆才长得高，可是他都不肯喝，最后自己去拿了一瓶果汁。
lines.pinyin: Tā běnlái yào mǎi, wǒ gēn tā shuō hē niúnǎi huòshì dòujiāng cái zhǎng de gāo, kěshì tā dōu bù kěn hē, zuìhòu zìjǐ qù ná le yì píng guǒzhī.
lines.english: He was going to, but I told him milk or soy milk is what makes you grow tall. He wouldn't drink either, though, and in the end he went and got a bottle of juice himself.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧。下次換我帶他去買吧。
lines.simplified: 好吧。下次换我带他去买吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Xià cì huàn wǒ dài tā qù mǎi ba.
lines.english: All right. Next time I'll take him shopping.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼這麼晚才回來？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么这么晚才回来？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme zhème wǎn cái huílái?
prompt.english: Why are they back so late?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ páiduì de rén hěn duō.
choices.english: There was a long line in the store.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Règǒu yào děng bàn ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: The hot dog took half an hour.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen qù de chāoshāng bǐjiào yuǎn.
choices.english: The store they went to was farther away.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Érzi hěn nán juédìng chī shénme.
choices.english: The son found it hard to decide what to eat.

questions.why: 一會兒要吃熱狗，一會兒又說要吃泡麵，選了半個小時: the son kept switching between foods, so deciding took half an hour. The father says 店裡人不多, the half hour was spent choosing, not waiting, and the store is the one downstairs.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 兒子最後拿了什麼喝的？
prompt.simplified: 儿子最后拿了什么喝的？
prompt.pinyin: Érzi zuìhòu ná le shénme hē de?
prompt.english: What drink did the son take in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Niúnǎi.
choices.english: Milk.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qìshuǐ.
choices.english: Soda.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Guǒzhī.
choices.english: Juice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dòujiāng.
choices.english: Soy milk.

questions.why: 他都不肯喝，最後自己去拿了一瓶果汁: he refused the milk and soy milk his father suggested and took juice. He wanted soda at first.

focus.en: what he took in the end

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段通知，然後回答兩個問題。

Wǎnshàng huí jiā de shíhòu, wǒ chángcháng yòng diàn lǐ de jīqì lái fù tíngchē fèi, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn. Shàng ge yuè yǒu yì tiān wǎnshàng, wǒ wàng le dài yàoshi, mén dǎ bù kāi, zhǐhǎo qù diàn lǐ qǐng diànyuán bāngmáng. Jīngguò bàn ge xiǎoshí, tā cái bāng wǒ zhǎodào rén lái kāi mén, wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎndòng. Jiùsuàn yǒu de dōngxi bǐ chāoshì guì yìdiǎn, wǒ yě yuànyì zài zhèlǐ mǎi, yīnwèi zhè jiā diàn ràng wǒ de shēnghuó fāngbiàn duō le.
passage.english: There is a convenience store downstairs from my home, open twenty-four hours. I got used to going there every day long ago. Its coffee is good, and the price isn't high either. On my way home in the evening, I often use the store's machine to pay my parking fees: it is quick and easy. One evening last month I forgot my keys and couldn't open the door, so I went to the store to ask the clerk for help. After half an hour, he finally found someone to open the door for me, and I was really touched. Even if some things cost a little more than at the supermarket, I'm happy to buy them here, because this store makes my life much easier.

Zuìjìn, gōngsī yòng wǎnshàng miànbāo dǎzhé de fāngshì lái xīyǐn gùkè, kèrén bǐ yǐqián duō le hěn duō, diàn lǐ yìzhí yǒu rén, tā chángcháng máng de zǒu bù kāi, lián chīfàn de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu. Wǒ wèn tā wèishénme bú huàn gōngzuò, tā shuō: “Suīrán gōngzuò hěn lèi, kěshì wǒ bù xiǎng huàn. Jīngguò zhè jǐ ge yuè, diàn lǐ de jīqì wǒ dōu huì yòng le. Zàishuō, lǎobǎn duì wǒ yě hěn hǎo.” Tīng le tā de huà, wǒ yě xiǎng qù nàlǐ dǎgōng le.
passage.english: My roommate works part-time at the convenience store next to our school. She says the work is very busy: one moment she is sending parcels for customers, the next she is taking out the rubbish and washing cups. Lately the company has been attracting customers with cheap bread in the evening, and there are many more customers than before. The store is never empty, and she is often too busy to get away, without even time to eat. I asked her why she doesn't change jobs. She said, "Although the work is tiring, I don't want to change. After these few months, I can use every machine in the store. Besides, the boss is good to me too." After hearing her, I want to work there too.

text.traditional: 在我住的地方，走路五分鐘就能看到三家超商。很多人覺得太多了，可是我不這麼想，因為每一家店的客人都不少。我想，這主要是因為大家的需求越來越多。以前的人去超商，只買飲料和零食；現在的人在那裡領錢、寄東西、付電話費，有的人還在那裡吃早飯、看書。超商用越來越多的服務來吸引顧客，大家的生活也越來越離不開超商。不過，這也有不好的地方。我家對面有一家開了三十年的麵包店，客人越來越少，上個月不開了。老闆說，現在大家都去超商買麵包。超商雖然方便，可是我還是希望這些老店能留下來。

text.pinyin: Zài wǒ zhù de dìfāng, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù néng kàndào sān jiā chāoshāng. Hěn duō rén juéde tài duō le, kěshì wǒ bú zhème xiǎng, yīnwèi měi yì jiā diàn de kèrén dōu bù shǎo. Wǒ xiǎng, zhè zhǔyào shì yīnwèi dàjiā de xūqiú yuè lái yuè duō. Yǐqián de rén qù chāoshāng, zhǐ mǎi yǐnliào hé língshí; xiànzài de rén zài nàlǐ lǐng qián, jì dōngxi, fù diànhuà fèi, yǒu de rén hái zài nàlǐ chī zǎofàn, kàn shū. Chāoshāng yòng yuè lái yuè duō de fúwù lái xīyǐn gùkè, dàjiā de shēnghuó yě yuè lái yuè lí bù kāi chāoshāng. Búguò, zhè yě yǒu bù hǎo de dìfāng. Wǒ jiā duìmiàn yǒu yì jiā kāi le sānshí nián de miànbāo diàn, kèrén yuè lái yuè shǎo, shàng ge yuè bù kāi le. Lǎobǎn shuō, xiànzài dàjiā dōu qù chāoshāng mǎi miànbāo. Chāoshāng suīrán fāngbiàn, kěshì wǒ háishì xīwàng zhèxiē lǎo diàn néng liú xiàlái.
text.english: Where I live, you can find three convenience stores within a five-minute walk. Many people think that is too many, but I don't, because every one of them has plenty of customers. I think this is mainly because people need more and more things. People used to go to convenience stores only for drinks and snacks; now they withdraw money, send things and pay phone bills there, and some even eat breakfast and read there. The stores attract customers with more and more services, and people's lives depend on them more and more. But this has a bad side too. Across from my home there was a bakery that had been open for thirty years. It had fewer and fewer customers and closed last month. The owner said everyone buys bread at convenience stores now. Convenience stores are handy, but I still hope these old shops can stay.

text.simplified: 我奶奶住在南部的乡下。以前那里没有超商，晚上八点以后，商店都不开了，想买东西只能等明天。三年前，那里开了第一家超商，奶奶的生活也改变了很多。她不但常常去那里买牛奶和面包，也在那里领钱，不用再坐一个小时的车去银行了。刚开始，她不会用店里的机器，店员就一次一次地教她。经过几个月，她已经能自己用机器买火车票了。奶奶常说，那里的店员就像她的家人一样，看到她就跟她聊天。我觉得，对住在乡下的老人来说，超商不但是买东西的地方，也是一个可以跟人聊天的地方。

Sān nián qián, nàlǐ kāi le dì-yī jiā chāoshāng, nǎinai de shēnghuó yě gǎibiàn le hěn duō. Tā búdàn chángcháng qù nàlǐ mǎi niúnǎi hé miànbāo, yě zài nàlǐ lǐng qián, búyòng zài zuò yí ge xiǎoshí de chē qù yínháng le. Gāng kāishǐ, tā bú huì yòng diàn lǐ de jīqì, diànyuán jiù yí cì yí cì de jiāo tā. Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè, tā yǐjīng néng zìjǐ yòng jīqì mǎi huǒchē piào le. Nǎinai cháng shuō, nàlǐ de diànyuán jiù xiàng tā de jiārén yíyàng, kàndào tā jiù gēn tā liáotiān. Wǒ juéde, duì zhù zài xiāngxià de lǎorén lái shuō, chāoshāng búdàn shì mǎi dōngxi de dìfāng, yě shì yí ge kěyǐ gēn rén liáotiān de dìfāng.
text.english: My grandmother lives in the countryside in the south. There used to be no convenience store there; after eight in the evening the shops closed, and if you wanted to buy something you had to wait until the next day. Three years ago the first convenience store opened there, and her life changed a lot. She often buys milk and bread there, and she also withdraws money there, so she no longer has to ride an hour to the bank. At first she couldn't use the store's machines, so the clerks taught her again and again. After a few months, she could buy train tickets on the machine by herself. Grandma often says the clerks are like family: when they see her, they chat with her. I think that for old people in the countryside, a convenience store is not only a place to shop but also a place to talk with people.

text.traditional: 我小時候的夢想常常改變。七歲的時候，我在電視上看到總統，就跟大家說我將來要當總統；十歲的時候，我很喜歡看卡通，又說要當畫卡通的人；上了中學，我因為一位律師幫了我們家很大的忙，而決定要念法律。爸爸媽媽從來沒笑過我，他們總是說：「不管你想做什麼，只要肯努力就好。」現在我念大學三年級，念的就是法律，也越來越喜歡了。我覺得夢想變來變去沒有關係，因為每一個夢想都讓我更知道自己喜歡什麼。再說，有了夢想，人才會不斷地努力。
text.simplified: 我小时候的梦想常常改变。七岁的时候，我在电视上看到总统，就跟大家说我将来要当总统；十岁的时候，我很喜欢看卡通，又说要当画卡通的人；上了中学，我因为一位律师帮了我们家很大的忙，而决定要念法律。爸爸妈妈从来没笑过我，他们总是说：「不管你想做什么，只要肯努力就好。」现在我念大学三年级，念的就是法律，也越来越喜欢了。我觉得梦想变来变去没有关系，因为每一个梦想都让我更知道自己喜欢什么。再说，有了梦想，人才会不断地努力。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu de mèngxiǎng chángcháng gǎibiàn. Qī suì de shíhòu, wǒ zài diànshì shàng kàndào zǒngtǒng, jiù gēn dàjiā shuō wǒ jiānglái yào dāng zǒngtǒng; shí suì de shíhòu, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn kǎtōng, yòu shuō yào dāng huà kǎtōng de rén; shàng le zhōngxué, wǒ yīnwèi yí wèi lǜshī bāng le wǒmen jiā hěn dà de máng, ér juédìng yào niàn fǎlǜ. Bàba māma cónglái méi xiào guo wǒ, tāmen zǒngshì shuō: “Bùguǎn nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme, zhǐyào kěn nǔlì jiù hǎo.” Xiànzài wǒ niàn dàxué sān niánjí, niàn de jiù shì fǎlǜ, yě yuè lái yuè xǐhuān le. Wǒ juéde mèngxiǎng biàn lái biàn qù méiyǒu guānxi, yīnwèi měi yí ge mèngxiǎng dōu ràng wǒ gèng zhīdào zìjǐ xǐhuān shénme. Zàishuō, yǒu le mèngxiǎng, rén cái huì búduàn de nǔlì.
text.english: My dream changed a lot when I was small. At seven I saw the president on TV and told everyone I would be president one day; at ten I loved cartoons and said I would draw them; in high school, because a lawyer had helped my family a great deal, I decided to study law. My parents never laughed at me. They always said, "Whatever you want to do, just be willing to work hard." Now I'm in my third year at university, studying law, and I like it more and more. I think it's fine for a dream to keep changing, because each dream showed me better what I like. Besides, only when you have a dream do you keep working hard.

text.traditional: 我哥哥是一個性格很開朗的人。大學畢業以後，他決定去國外學做西餐。剛到那裡的時候，雖然他的外語說得不錯，可是常常因為不習慣那裡做菜的方式而做錯菜。他每天早上五點就到餐廳工作，晚上十一點才回家，吃了很多苦。可是他從來沒想過回來，因為他知道這是自己選的路。三年以後，他不但適應了那裡的生活，還進了一家有名的餐廳工作。上個月他回臺灣，做了很多菜給我們吃，大家都說，這可以說是我們吃過最好吃的西餐。他說，他現在的夢想是回臺灣開一家自己的餐廳。
text.simplified: 我哥哥是一个性格很开朗的人。大学毕业以后，他决定去国外学做西餐。刚到那里的时候，虽然他的外语说得不错，可是常常因为不习惯那里做菜的方式而做错菜。他每天早上五点就到餐厅工作，晚上十一点才回家，吃了很多苦。可是他从来没想过回来，因为他知道这是自己选的路。三年以后，他不但适应了那里的生活，还进了一家有名的餐厅工作。上个月他回台湾，做了很多菜给我们吃，大家都说，这可以说是我们吃过最好吃的西餐。他说，他现在的梦想是回台湾开一家自己的餐厅。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì yí ge xìnggé hěn kāilǎng de rén. Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, tā juédìng qù guówài xué zuò xīcān. Gāng dào nàlǐ de shíhòu, suīrán tā de wàiyǔ shuō de búcuò, kěshì chángcháng yīnwèi bù xíguàn nàlǐ zuò cài de fāngshì ér zuò cuò cài. Tā měi tiān zǎoshàng wǔ diǎn jiù dào cāntīng gōngzuò, wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn cái huí jiā, chī le hěn duō kǔ. Kěshì tā cónglái méi xiǎng guo huílái, yīnwèi tā zhīdào zhè shì zìjǐ xuǎn de lù. Sān nián yǐhòu, tā búdàn shìyìng le nàlǐ de shēnghuó, hái jìn le yì jiā yǒumíng de cāntīng gōngzuò. Shàng ge yuè tā huí Táiwān, zuò le hěn duō cài gěi wǒmen chī, dàjiā dōu shuō, zhè kěyǐ shuō shì wǒmen chī guo zuì hǎochī de xīcān. Tā shuō, tā xiànzài de mèngxiǎng shì huí Táiwān kāi yì jiā zìjǐ de cāntīng.
text.english: My older brother is a very cheerful person. After university he decided to go abroad to learn Western cooking. When he first got there, although he spoke the language well, he often cooked dishes wrong because he was not used to the way they cooked there. He went to the restaurant at five every morning and got home at eleven at night; he went through a lot. But he never thought of coming back, because he knew this was the road he had chosen. Three years later he had not only adapted to life there but had got a job at a famous restaurant. Last month he came back to Taiwan and cooked lots of dishes for us; everyone said you could call it the best Western food we had ever eaten. He says his dream now is to come back to Taiwan and open his own restaurant.
